values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

note: Rustic state forest campground on the Munuscong River inside the Munuscong State Wildlife Management Area near Pickford, managed by Brimley State Park; the river leads about a mile to Lake Munuscong. Wildlife viewing, fishing and hunting; ORVs may ride between the campground and the trails. 15.4 mi SW of Munuscong via South Riverside Drive. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 25 sites for tent and small trailer (count confirmed; length silent), $20 + Recreation Passport (confirmed), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only (confirmed), 15-day maximum (inherited, now confirmed). Season year_round false -> opens 05-12, closes 11-30 (closure Dec 1 - May 11). Boat ramp.
